title: Persona and personality
slide_intent: Give a brand personality a social role writers can imagine. Describing how a colleague acts helps a reader turn abstract attributes into behavior.
strategic_value: Slack can anchor its public manner in the ideal colleague described by the guide, giving writers a way to calibrate their voice.
demonstration: An oversized list of qualities occupies the left column. Supporting paragraphs at right connect the company culture to communication and describe an ideal colleague.
practical_value: Compare a proposed message with the colleague described here: consider whether the speaker listens, explains and helps the reader.
